Interactive assistant for adding a new data source

Source: R/add_source_assistant.R
ehr_add_source_assistant.Rd

The "add a new source" counterpart to ehr_setup_assistant(). Run interactively, it asks a short series of questions (ID columns, time origin, cohort strategy, …), then either scaffolds the source with add_source_wizard(), prints the equivalent add_source_wizard() call for you to run, or validates the assembled spec without writing anything. Every input is also a keyword argument, so the same call works non-interactively in a script.

Usage

ehr_add_source_assistant(
  name = NULL,
  root = NULL,
  select_id_cols = NULL,
  id_default = NULL,
  id_icu = NULL,
  tables_with_icu = NULL,
  time_origin = NULL,
  time_diff = NULL,
  cohort_key = NULL,
  cohort_seed_tables = NULL,
  diag_table = NULL,
  code_col = NULL,
  filter_key = NULL,
  split_commas = NULL,
  strip_dots = NULL,
  id_prefixes = NULL,
  icu_id_type = NULL,
  demo_row_limit = NULL,
  action = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  interactive = base::interactive()
)

Arguments

name

Source family name (lowercase, no _demo).

root

Config directory to scaffold into. Defaults to EHR_EXTERNAL_CONFIG_ROOT.

select_id_cols

ID columns carried into every concept table, coarse → fine. A vector, or a comma-separated string.

id_default

Join key(s) for non-ICU tables. Defaults to select_id_cols.

id_icu, tables_with_icu

Finer ICU-level join key and the tables that carry it. Omit for a single granularity.

time_origin

visit_windows column used as t=0 (e.g. "cw.admittime").

time_diff

"timestamp_minutes" or "offset_minutes".

cohort_key

Patient/stay ID used to subset every table.

cohort_seed_tables

Tables imported first so cohort IDs can be built.

diag_table, code_col, filter_key, split_commas, strip_dots

Fields of the declarative cohort_filter that selects cohorts by ICD code (see vignette("adding-a-new-source")). filter_key defaults to cohort_key.

id_prefixes

Advanced: source-name prefixes matched by src_family(). Defaults to name. Only needed when variant names don't start with name.

icu_id_type

Advanced: SQL type of the ICU-level id ("bigint" default; use "text" for string stay IDs).

demo_row_limit

Row cap for the <name>_demo variant. Default 1000.

action

"write" (scaffold + register via add_source_wizard()), "script" (print the call, touch nothing), or "dry_run" (validate the spec only). Defaults to "write" interactively and to "script" otherwise, so a non-interactive call writes nothing unless asked.

overwrite

Passed to add_source_wizard() when action = "write".

interactive

Ask questions on the console? Defaults to interactive().

Value

Invisibly, an ehr_add_source_plan: the collected spec, the rendered call, the chosen action, any result (wizard/validation output), and next_steps.

Details

It collects choices and hands them to add_source_wizard(); it does not write your source-specific SQL (window_tables.sql, schema DDL) or concept-config rows — those are reported as next steps.

See also

add_source_wizard(), register_source(), validate_source_config()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ehr_add_source_assistant(name = "my_icu", root = "~/data/my_icu")
} # }
